create.title: Coupled dyadic-scale telescope and sharp alpha capacity no-go
create.statement_tex: For adjacent interior active scales D_(j+1)=D_j/2 and H_(j+1)=floor(H_j/2), the exact common-line finite difference has multiplier 2^(-u)((H_(j+1)+1)/(H_j+1))^v-1, which has order-one size at a uniformly bounded imaginary v-height. After licensed physical return and zero extension, B_(j+1)-B_j=(P_(j+1)-P_j)F_(j+1)+P_j(F_(j+1)-F_j), with scale stars and height supports retained separately and the product star and external X^(1/4) factor owned once. The exact W=eta-eta(2 dot) Abel identity retains the hard top, inactive bottom, and all differences a_(H_j)-a_(H_(j-1)), whose l1 masses are (H_(j-1)-H_j)/2. Original fixed-(h,q) scale terms are nonnegative multiples of one common chi_4(q)e(sqrt(Xhq)) phase, so the physical scale label supplies no signed cancellation. For arbitrarily large square X, the penultimate active interior pair, h=1, and odd q in [25X/(4D_j^2),64X/(9D_j^2)] form a star-free strict-product shell on which exactly one profile is nonzero and sum_q q^(-3/4)|B_(j+1)-B_j| >> X^(1/8). Thus adjacent differencing, raw profile telescoping, scale BV, and scale-only Abel summation cannot provide the required power saving. This is an absolute-capacity obstruction, not a signed lower bound for the complete projected alpha operator.
create.next_action: Work after the scale sum. Preserve the actual chi_4 divisor coefficient and radial phase; derive a coefficient-sensitive signed correlation or shifted-convolution estimate rather than another profile telescope.

update.statement_tex: The connector-completed alpha-bounded zeta-high trace is the signed projected cosine-comb/GAR-return operator. The Vaaler height floor has zero contour velocity, and the complete adjacent dyadic-scale algebra is now audited: its finite multiplier has full bulk size, its physical scale terms are phase-coherent and nonnegative at every fixed (h,q), and a star-free actual adjacent pair retains normalized absolute capacity >>X^(1/8). Hence floor incidence, unit-height variation, raw W telescoping, profile BV, adjacent differencing, and scale-only Abel summation cannot supply the missing power. The remaining theorem must exploit cancellation across distinct (h,q) or product fibers in the fully connector-completed projected operator, retain the signed Plemelj order and all outside-height boundaries, and recover both the normalized X^(-1/8+o(1)) lattice gain and the separate height-Cauchy gain.

The actual dyadic transfer has been resolved by M9-M1-alpha-coupled-dyadic-scale-capacity-no-go. Use the height lemma only as typed coefficient infrastructure, not as a saving mechanism.

reject.reason: The exact W telescope retains both scale boundaries and coherent dyadic height-profile differences of mass (H_(j-1)-H_j)/2; it only reorganizes the positive scale mass.
Adjacent differences telescope tautologically to endpoint blocks and are not the original scale sum. At fixed (h,q), original physical scale terms have one phase and nonnegative magnitudes.
A strict star-free actual-profile shell inside one adjacent pair has normalized absolute mass >>X^(1/8), so profile BV or absolute scale accounting cannot provide a power gain.
